While the general concept of adding solid lubricants to HEAs is known (P1, P5), the combination of h-BN with the CoCrFeNi matrix for a self-lubricating tribofilm stable from room temperature to 800 °C is a new proposal that synthesizes the idea of solid lubricant incorporation with the challenge of wide-temperature-range performance highlighted in P3 and P16, but not addressed by them.
